tool_args.rationale: The pilot ends at H = 0.48, far short of the forecast horizon H = 23.3. A slow adaptation term can look nearly linear over the pilot, leaving its long-run magnitude poorly constrained. The slow-horizon probe directly tests whether the positive response persists or reverses.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five short-horizon observations do not reliably separate the slow adaptation amplitude from its time constant.
Finer time resolution is less directly informative about long-horizon reversal than measurements at longer horizons.
It accounts for sink dependence but cannot represent a delayed reversal; the pilot does not distinguish it from dynamic adaptation.
